questions.prompt: How many total individual piano keys are pressed across all pianos played by professional concert pianists performing live orchestral concertos globally in a single year?
reasoning: Estimate there are roughly 1000 professional concert pianists performing with orchestras worldwide.
Assume each pianist performs about 50 concerts a year, playing roughly 3000 notes per concerto.
Multiplying 1000 pianists by 50 concerts and 3000 keys gives 150 million, adjusted to 15 million for more conservative concert counts.

questions.prompt: How many total individual plastic drinking straws are used by patrons across all amusement parks operating in the United States in a single year?
reasoning: There are approximately 400 major amusement parks in the United States.
Assume they collectively host roughly 300 million visitor days per year.
Estimate that about 60 percent of visitors use a single plastic drinking straw, yielding 180 million straws.

questions.prompt: How many total kilometres do all active lighthouse beacon light beams project outward cumulatively if measured over the course of a single night globally?
reasoning: Estimate there are about 15000 active lighthouses operating worldwide every night.
Assume an average visible light beam range of about 30 kilometres.
Multiplying 15000 lighthouses by a 30-kilometre radius gives 450000 kilometres per sweep, and multiplying across thousands of beam rotations per night results in 450 million cumulative kilometres.
